source_note: 逐字原文以用户日志为准; 社区 Wiki 普通页面用于核对语境。日志未保留颜色码的消息不伪造 raw; 分段按语义边界保留运行时颜色。

messages.context: 宾果药水 NPC 首次介绍
messages.text: I'm here to help you with Bingo!
messages.zh: 我来助你完成宾果挑战!
messages.raw: §fI'm here to help you with Bingo!

messages.text: Come to me if you want some Potion Effects to help you in your journey!
messages.zh: 冒险时想要药水效果助你一臂之力,就来找我!
messages.raw: §fCome to me if you want some §dPotion Effects§f to help you in your journey!

segments.text: Come to me if you want some
to help you in your journey!
segments.zh: 助你一臂之力,就来找我!

messages.text: I can give you better effects depending on your Bingo Level.
messages.zh: 你的宾果等级越高,我能提供的药水效果就越好。
messages.raw: §fI can give you better effects depending on your Bingo Level.

messages.text: I gave you potions recently! Give me some time to prepare new ones!
messages.zh: 刚刚才给过你药水呢! 等我准备好新的一批再来吧!
messages.raw: §fI gave you potions recently! Give me some time to prepare new ones!
